# The rework's byte oracle (internal/QA-Plan.md §0), read by Format/OracleTests.
# One line per case: key, SHA-256 of the writer's output, the output in hex. A frame encrypted with
# AES-256-GCM is recorded as its header followed by its body decrypted in counter mode.
# A line "key | sha hex" is a further admissible output of the case above it: ImmutableDictionary with
# string keys enumerates in the order of the runtime's randomized string hash, so its two entries may
# be written in either order.
